Ready to see what Base44 can do for you? Get started →When you start looking for the best AI website builders, what you usually want is simple: a fast, stress-free way to build a no code website that still looks professional. Thankfully, AI finally makes that possible.This guide walks you through the top AI website builders, how they work, what makes them different and which one is best for your needs. You’ll also learn what to look for in an AI website builder and what AI website design actually means. If you’re ready to compare tools side-by-side, from Base44 to the best AI app builders, this guide will help you choose the right platform and start building with confidence.Base44 is an AI app builder that lets anyone describe what they want in plain language and get a working web app or website back in minutes, complete with built-in data, logic and integrations.TL;DR: best AI website buildersAI website builders use artificial intelligence to streamline the creation process, generating custom designs, content and layouts based on your input. This makes it incredibly easy for anyone, regardless of experience, to build a professional website. We’ve reviewed the top options to help you find the perfect fit for your project. If you’re wondering how to vibe code a website or why vibe code a website, the platforms below will give you a clear picture of what’s possible with today’s AI tools.Base44: Best overall for service-based businesses collaborative AI workflows and users looking for a straightforward, all-in-one platform with marketing tools.
Wix: A solid platform known for its powerful AI tools combined with extensive customization options.
Appy Pie: Perfect for users who want to build both a website and a mobile app from one platform.
Gamma: Excellent for creating presentations and simple, one-page websites with an AI-first approach.
Kleap: Suited for creators and entrepreneurs who want to build a mobile-first "link-in-bio" style site.
Jimdo: Great for beginners and small businesses needing a simple, fast and mobile-optimized site.

Month-to-month payment options available. 7 best AI website buildersBelow you’ll find a full breakdown of the best AI website builders, what they offer and how they compare.Base44WixAppy PieGammaKleapJimdo10Web01. Base44Base44 is an AI-powered platform designed to be an all-in-one solution for service-based businesses. It doesn't just build you a website. With Base44 you can prompt the AI to add anything your business needs, from a client portal to a booking form to a data tracker, and connect it to your existing services through Base44 integrations.The AI builder asks for your business details and generates a website tailored to your services, helping you attract and manage clients from one central place. You can also tap into Base44 app templates to speed up setup even further.Ideal for: Teams, startups, creators and marketers who want a collaborative AI design flow rather than a fully automated “done-for-you” website.AI-assisted content and layout generationTeam commenting and shared workspacesComponents-based editingClean, modern templatesPricing: Free plan. Paid plans start at $16/mo (billed annually)."One of the most powerful things about Base44 is how it democratizes app building. You don’t need a massive budget or a team of developers to create something impactful. It’s a game-changer for small businesses and solo entrepreneurs." - Ilay Granot, Marketing at Base44Learn more about Base44: What is Base44?How to use Base44How much does Base44 cost?Base44 vs LovableBase44 vs ReplitHow much does it cost to build a website with AI?02. WixWix is one of the most advanced AI website builders on the market, offering not just AI-created layouts but also AI-powered content, branding, marketing, eCommerce and SEO tools. It can create a complete, customized website in minutes, including colors, fonts, images and copy tailored to your business type. It’s also extremely flexible thanks to its drag-and-drop editor, marketplace of 450+ apps, and full business infrastructure.Ideal for: Small businesses, entrepreneurs, service providers, online stores, content creators and anyone who wants a complete website with built-in business tools.Notable features:AI website builder that creates a full site instantlyAI Assistant for text, images and brandingAdvanced eCommerce and point-of-sale (POS)SEO tools and AI metadata suggestionsBookings, blogs, events, restaurant tools and moreFull design freedom with drag-and-drop editing"We faced the challenge of showcasing our passion for creativity while managing ticket sales and advertising for our events. Then we discovered the AI website builder from Wix, which made the entry process incredibly easy for us. After the basic structure of our website was set up, we established ticket sales and email marketing." - Charlotte & Clara Jeroma, Founders of Calla ConceptPricing: Free plan. Paid plans start at $17/mo (billed annually).03. Appy PieAppy Pie offers a fast, streamlined AI website builder that focuses on speed and simplicity. You answer a few questions, select a theme and the platform generates a functional website you can publish quickly. It’s ideal for basic sites and users who want minimal complexity.Ideal for: Small businesses, individuals and beginners wanting a fast, simple, no-code solution.Notable features:AI-assisted website creationOne-page and small websitesNo-code app and automation integrationsBasic SEO setupPricing: Free trail available. Paid plans start at $16/app/mo. 04. GammaGamma is known for AI-generated presentations and visual storytelling, but it also creates sleek landing pages and web-style layouts. It’s not a traditional website builder, but it’s a powerful tool for quickly turning ideas into polished content you can publish online.Ideal for: Marketers, content creators, educators and founders who need landing pages, presentations or pitch decks.Notable features:AI-generated slides and landing pagesClean, highly visual templatesInstant rewriting and reformattingEasy sharing and web publishingPricing: Free plan. Paid plans start at $8/seat/mo (billed annually).05. KleapKleap is a mobile-first AI website builder designed to make personal websites, portfolios and online profiles quick to create and easy to manage. Its editor is optimized for mobile devices, making it a great choice for creators who want to build on the go.Ideal for: Creators, freelancers, influencers and solopreneurs who prioritize mobile-first design and simple, minimal sites.Notable features:AI text and layout suggestionsMobile-first editorSimple landing page templatesPortfolio and link-in-bio style designsPricing: Free trial available. Paid plans start at $3/mo.06. JimdoJimdo is a long-time website builder known for simplicity, and its AI-driven builder helps beginners create a site by answering a few quick questions. It generates a clean, functional layout and pulls in business info automatically if you choose.Ideal for: Beginners, small businesses and users who want hands-off website creation.Notable features:AI website builderAutomatic industry layoutsBuilt-in business listingsSimple store and appointment toolsClean, minimalist templatesPricing: Free plan. Paid plans start at $11/mo (billed annually).07. 10Web10Web is an AI-powered WordPress automation platform that helps you build, optimize and manage WordPress websites. Its standout capability is recreating existing websites in WordPress using AI, which saves developers hours of manual work.Ideal for: Agencies, freelancers and WordPress users who want faster development and automated optimization.Notable features:AI website recreation from a URLAI-generated layoutsWordPress hosting and optimizationPageSpeed and performance toolsDrag-and-drop editor powered by ElementorPricing: Free plan. Paid plans start at $10/mo (billed annually).How to choose the right AI website builderThe right AI website builder depends on what you're actually trying to build. If you need a polished marketing site fast, AI website builders like Base44 or Wix are strong choices because they generate complete multi-page sites instantly and come with hosting, SEO and business features built in.If your site needs to do more than display content, like collect form submissions, manage bookings, show live data or give users personalized access, you'll want a builder that creates functional web apps and not just static pages. That's where Base44 stands apart: instead of generating a website template, it builds fully working apps you can interact with, customize and grow as your needs change.What makes the best AI website builders?Choosing the best AI website builder depends on your goals, but there are key features that separate great platforms from basic ones.Key qualities to look forTruly personalized results: The builder should generate layouts, text and design unique to your industry or goals, not generic templates.
Full customization: AI speed is great, but you still need creative control to edit your site afterward.
Built-in business tools: The best platforms include SEO, eCommerce, bookings, analytics and marketing tools.
Reliable hosting and performance: Fast load times and mobile responsiveness are non-negotiable.
AI-powered content and branding: Look for AI tools that write text, create images and support brand consistency.AI should make building faster, easier and more intentional, not limit your creativity.What is AI in website design?AI in website design refers to tools that use machine learning and automation to build, optimize, or enhance websites. Instead of starting from scratch, AI analyzes your goals, style preferences and business type to suggest or generate design elements automatically.AI can assist with:Creating full website layoutsWriting copy for pagesGenerating brand colors and stylesBuilding eCommerce structuresImproving SEO with metadata suggestionsRecommending user experience improvementsCompressing and enhancing imagesA/B testing and personalizationIn short, AI streamlines the website creation process so anyone, not just designers or developers, can build a site that looks polished and performs well.Want to see how this works in practice? Check out the full list of Base44 features to explore its AI capabilities.Editor’s note: Pricing reflects the most current rates on each platform as of December 8, 2025.Best AI website builders FAQWhat is the best AI website builder?The best AI website builder in 2025 depends on your goals, but top contenders include Base44 and Wix. Each tool uses AI differently, from generating full site layouts to writing content and optimizing performance. If you want fast, automated site generation with strong customization options, Base44 is a leading choice.What features should the best AI website builders include?The best AI website builders typically offer AI-powered site generation, responsive design, built-in SEO tools, fast editing and business-ready features like eCommerce, marketing or analytics. They should also provide strong performance, reliable hosting and easy controls that let you refine the AI-generated layout.What is AI in website design?AI website design refers to the use of artificial intelligence to create website layouts, content, images and structure automatically. Instead of manually choosing templates and designing each page, AI builders generate a full website for you based on your brand, business type and style preferences. You can then customize everything to match your vision.Are AI website builders good for beginners?Yes, AI website builders are ideal for beginners because they eliminate the steep learning curve of traditional website design. With tools like Base44 and others, all you need to do is answer a few prompts and the AI builds the foundation for you. You can then adjust colors, text and layout without needing coding or design skills.Can AI website builders create content for my site?Most modern AI builders can generate headlines, paragraphs, product descriptions and even on-brand messaging. Some platforms, including Base44, offer deeper content automation that tailors your copy to your industry or audience. You can always edit the AI-generated content to match your tone.Can I change something in an AI website builder just by prompting it?Yes, AI website builders like Base44 are built for what's often called conversational editing. Instead of dragging a button or an element like with a drag and drop website builder, you type something like: "Change the header to dark blue and move the contact form to the top," and the AI  website builder updates the code and your website in real-time.
